title: Mantion–Meax languages - Wikipedia
text: The Mantion–Meax, Mantion–Meyah, or (South) East Bird's Head languages are a language family of three languages in the "Bird's Head Peninsula" of western New Guinea, spoken by all together 20,000 people.

title: East Bird's Head–Sentani languages - Wikipedia
text: The East Bird's Head–Sentani languages form a family of Papuan languages proposed by Malcolm Ross which combines the East Bird's Head and Sentani families along with the Burmeso language isolate.

title: East Bird’s Head-Sentani jezici – Wikipedija
text: Istočnovogelkopski-Sentani jezici (East Bird’s Head-Sentani), jezična papuanska porodica koja se sastoji od skupina East Bird’s Head (nekad samostalna porodica) i 4 sentani jezika, nekad dio transnovogvinejske porodice, i nekad izoliranog burmeso jezika.

text: Apr 22, 2025 · Meyah, spoken by around 20,000 people in Papua, Indonesia, is part of the East Bird's Head family and is crucial to the cultural identity of the Meyah people.
